complete_quotes.greek: 164 κυκλάμινος· φύλλα ἔχει ὅμοια κισσῷ, ποικίλα δὲ κάτωθεν καὶ ἄνωθεν κηλῖσιν ὑπολεύκοις, καυλὸν δὲ τετραδάκτυλον, γυμνόν, ἐφ οὖ ἄνθη ῥοδοειδῆ, πορφυρίζοντα, ῥίζαν μέλαιναν, γογγυλίδι παραπλησίαν, ὑπόπλατυν, ἥτις ποθεῖσα μεθ᾿ ὑδρομέλιτος ἄγει φλέγμα καὶ ὕδωρ κάτω, καὶ ἔμμηνα δὲ κινεῖ πινομένη καὶ προστιθεμένη. φασὶ δὲ ὅτι, κἂν ὑπερβῇ τὴν ῥίζαν ἐγκύμων γυνή, ἐξαμβλώσκειν αὐτήν· ἔστι δὲ καὶ ὠκυτόκιον περιαπτομένη. πίνεται δὲ πρὸς τὰ θανάσιμα μετ᾿ οἴνου, καὶ μάλιστα πρὸς λαγωὸν θαλάσσιον, καὶ ἑρπετῶν ἐστιν ἀντιφάρμακον καταπλασσομένη, μεθύσκει τε οἴνῳ μειχθεῖσα.

ἀποκαθίστησι δὲ καὶ ἴκτερον τριῶν δραχμῶν πλῆθος ποθεῖσα 2 μετὰ γλυκέος ἢ μελικράτου ὑδαροῦς — κατακλίνειν δὲ δεῖ τὸν πίνοντα ἐν οἴκῳ θερμῷ καὶ πλείοσιν ἱματίοις περιβάλλειν, ὅπως ἱδρώσῃ· δ δὲ ἀποκρινόμενος ἱδρὼς χολώδης εὑρίσκεται τῇ χρόᾳ — ἐγχυματίζεταί τε ὁ χυλὸς αὐτῆς μετὰ μέλιτος εἰς τὰς ῥῖνας πρὸς κάθαρσιν κεφαλῆς, καὶ τῷ δακτυλίῳ ἐν ἐρίῳ προστίθεται πρὸς κομιδὴν περιττωμάτων. καταχρισθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπ᾿ ὀμφαλοῦ καὶ ὑπογαστρίου καὶ ἰσχίου κοιλίαν μαλάσσει καὶ ἐκτρρσμοὺς ἐργάζεται, καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ὑποκεχυμένους καὶ ἀμβλυωποῦντας ἐγχριόμενος ὁ χυλὸς σὺν μέλιτι ἁρμόζει· μείγνυται καὶ εἰς τὰ φθόρια, ἕδραν τε προπεσοῦσαν σὺν ὄξει καταχριόμενος ὁ χυλὸς καθίστησι.

χυλίζεται δὲ ἡ ῥίζα κοπτομένη καὶ ἐκθλιβομένη, 3 ἑψομένου τοῦ χυλοῦ ἄχρι μελιτώδους συστάσεως. ῥύπτει δὲ καὶ χρῶτα ἡ ῥίζα καὶ ἐξανθήματα στέλλει, καὶ τραύματα μετ᾿ ὄξους καὶ καθ᾿ ἑαυτὴν καὶ μετὰ μέλιτος ἰᾶται. καταπλασσομένη δὲ καὶ σπλῆνα τήκει, ἀποκαθαίρει δὲ καὶ ἔφηλιν καὶ ἀλωπεκίας, εὐθετεῖ δὲ καὶ πρὸς στρέμματα καὶ ποδάγραν. τὸ δὲ ἀφέψημα αὐτῆς ποιεῖ πρὸς τὰ ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἑλκύδρια καὶ χιμέτλας καταντλούμενον, αὐτή τε δἰ ἐλαίου παλαιοῦ ἀναζεσθεῖσα καταχριομένου τοῦ ἐλαίου.

4 ἐγκοιλανθεῖσα δὲ πληροῦται τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ τίθεται ἐπὶ θερμοσποδιᾶς, προσεμβάλλεται δὲ ἐνίοτε καὶ κηροῦ Τυρρηνικοῦ ὀλίγον, ὡς γλοιῶδες γενέσθαι, κατάχρισμα ἄριστον χιμετλιῶσιν. ἀποτίθεται δὲ ἡ ῥίζα τμηθεῖσα ὥσπερ σκίλλα. ἱστορεῖται δὲ καὶ πρὸς φίλτρα αὐτὴν λαμβάνεσθαι καεῖσαν ἀναπλασθεἰσάν τε εἰς τροχίσκους, φύεται δὲ ἐν συσκίοις τόποις, μάλιστα δὲ ὑπὸ τὰ δένδρα.

central_greek: τὸ δὲ ἀφέψημα αὐτῆς ποιεῖ πρὸς τὰ ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἑλκύδρια καὶ χιμέτλας καταντλούμενον, αὐτή τε δἰ ἐλαίου παλαιοῦ ἀναζεσθεῖσα καταχριομένου τοῦ ἐλαίου.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Decoction is a neuter nominal head; αὐτῆς is a feminine genitive reference to the root locally named repeatedly.
grammatical_ownership.inferred: Root antecedent is strongly licensed by the local root discourse, not a new plant identity or relation to an independently identified target.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Neuter nominative participle agrees with ἀφέψημα: the decoction is poured over/douched onto an application site.
grammatical_ownership.not_licensed: This is not the later oil application bearer, and not raw root automatically poured as if liquid.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Feminine nominative αὐτή and feminine singular aorist participle select the root itself as the subject of the next preparation. The immediately preceding neuter decoction cannot be this αὐτή by agreement.
grammatical_ownership.inferred: The previously named feminine root is the natural antecedent; not the masculine χυλός or neuter ἔλαιον.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Oil is the genitive medium/complement of διά; παλαιοῦ agrees in neuter genitive with ἐλαίου. Old qualifies oil, not feminine root.
grammatical_ownership.inferred: Rendering through/by/with oil as cooking in old oil is locally natural. It does not mean filtration through oil, an essence, or an independently measured oil age.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Preparation uses a boiling-up/heating-to-boil verb on the root. Boiled up in/with old oil is more specific than merely a generic warm-state property.
grammatical_ownership.not_licensed: No duration, temperature, heat source, vessel, repeated heating, order of addition, water, separate extraction or preservation mechanism is stated in this clause. No new lexicographic source was consulted; exact technical culinary rendering remains a translation choice.

grammatical_ownership.explicit: Genitive absolute with named neuter genitive oil and application/anointing participle: oil is what is smeared/applied.
grammatical_ownership.not_licensed: Neither root nor juice can replace the explicitly named application bearer. Root absence/removal, decanting, straining and molecular transfer are not stated. The same contextual oil is natural anaphora, not proof of a separately isolated batch.

indication_and_owner_continuation.preceding_explicit_indication: τὰ ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἑλκύδρια καὶ χιμέτλας: sores/ulcerations in/on the head and chilblains; ποιεῖ πρὸς says the decoction serves/is useful for these when poured over.
indication_and_owner_continuation.strongest_local_reading: αὐτή τε coordinates the root preparation with the preceding decoction clause and leaves the main useful-for predicate unexpressed. Carrying ποιεῖ πρὸς and those immediately preceding indications into the oil-preparation/application clause is the strongest economical elliptical reading.
indication_and_owner_continuation.explicit_vs_elliptical: The oil clause does not repeat an indication noun, named patient or application-site object. Shared head-sores/chilblains indication is supported by local coordination/ellipsis; it should be marked inherited, not quoted as a separately explicit oil-specific indication.
indication_and_owner_continuation.non_carryovers: Do not carry all preceding gout/sprain/spleen/wound/skin claims into oil merely because they occur in the entry. No same individual human patient is named in either of these adjacent clauses; shared indications do not prove patient coidentity. Head belongs to a patient only by ordinary anatomical interpretation, not an explicit ownership binder here.
indication_and_owner_continuation.section4_distinction: Section4 independently explicitly calls its resulting application best for sufferers from chilblains. That supports a local chilblain theme but does not turn section3 into the identical hollow-root/wax process or independently prove both section3 indications.

adjacent_counterexamples.evidence: ἐγκοιλανθεῖσα ... πληροῦται τοῦ ἐλαίου ... ἐπὶ θερμοσποδιᾶς ... ἐνίοτε ... κηροῦ Τυρρηνικοῦ ὀλίγον ... γλοιῶδες ... κατάχρισμα ... χιμετλιῶσιν.
